# What changes

**Stated changes.** The board itself changes: a sprawling wall is cut to "a maximum of 12" pink top-level milestones, overlaps consolidated into Guides Launch, Token Launch, Events Launch, Product Launch; Brand Launch merged with the Declaration; academic items folded into "one" papers series; Request for Guidance folded "under volunteer infrastructure"; the Sovereign Wealth Fund renamed "the dolphin fund." Trust Graph launch is locked for August because "it fits with the 42 game and it fits with the bots and it fits with the spell book." The Deep Thought / agent-heaven move is named "our version of the antidote to the fable issue," giving members "access to this specific model."

**Hedged or possible.** Two-year stretch goals stay hopeful and explicitly soft: the "un-singularity" of "human and non-human actors," "global consciousness realized," RWA Embassies / Hitchhiker HOA, "living sovereign compute," MySpace.earth "rewilded." Tokens come only "if they don't think that they're going to be spent" well; myspace is "the least accurate in terms of we don't know when."
